# sigma_saml_service_provider_certificate (Resource)

Certificate for a SAML service provider (Beta API; behaviour may change). Sigma generates the key pair; `active` activates or deactivates it. Composite ID `<saml_service_provider_id>:<certificate_id>`. Look up service provider IDs with data.sigma_saml_service_providers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sigma_saml_service_providers" "all" {}

resource "sigma_saml_service_provider_certificate" "signing" {
  saml_service_provider_id = data.sigma_saml_service_providers.all.ids[0]
  purpose                  = "signing"
  valid_for_days           = 365
  active                   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `purpose` (String) `signing` or `encryption`.
- `saml_service_provider_id` (String)
- `valid_for_days` (Number) Certificate lifetime in days, used only at creation. Not returned by Sigma, so changing it later has no effect; use `terraform apply -replace` to reissue.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the certificate is active. Defaults to the server state (new certificates are created inactive).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `not_after` (String)
- `not_before` (String)
- `public_key_certificate` (String) PEM public certificate to register with the identity provider.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sigma_saml_service_provider_certificate.example '<saml_service_provider_id>:<certificate_id>'
```
